Services

What the barbershop does

From the shop window and from what customers write in their Google reviews.

Haircuts

Customers write about a professional haircut and a perfect cut. The haircut comes up in 4 Google reviews.

Skin fades

One customer writes that the shop excels at skin fades and praises the attention to detail.

Shaves and trims

As the lettering on the shop window says: barber, shaves and trims.

How customers describe a visit

Taken from what customers write in their Google reviews.

Friendly

Customers describe good, kind people and a friendly environment.

Clean, with style

Google reviews mention the decor 3 times and the cleanliness 2 times. One customer calls the design amazing.

Coming back

Customers write that they are always happy when they leave and that they will come again.

Black, cream and stripes

The shop is at Platonos 1A in Strovolos: a black front with the name in cream letters, striped awnings and a barber pole on the facade. The logo shows two crossed razors and the year 2018.
